name: Samurai Sales Portal Connector
brief: Lets the Samurai Sales Portal post sales orders that need lot numbers.
description: Adds an API (samuraiFoods/portal/v1.0) with the actions assignLots and assignLotsAndPost on sales orders. Lot numbers are assigned first-expiry-first-out from the stock at the order line's location, then the order is posted (Ship and Invoice) for its Qty. to Ship / Qty. to Invoice.
